# Quotation response -- SOLMU-RFQ-2026-14

## Visakoivu Oy

Visakoivu Oy is a technical property services contractor based in Jyvaskyla, providing LVI, electrical, building automation and property maintenance services to public and private clients.

### Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy's liability insurance exceeds the required minimum coverage. Our revenue for the latest financial year exceeds the required threshold.

### Technical response

**Condition monitoring.** Data is collected during scheduled maintenance visits and logged centrally for trend review.

**Continuity.** Assignments are staffed by a team rather than a single individual, with documented handover on personnel changes, so a change in personnel does not interrupt service to the centre.

**Waste handling.** Waste generated on site is sorted according to the applicable site plan.

**Warranty.** Installed equipment carries our standard warranty terms.

**Electrical inspections.** Periodic inspection of electrical installations is carried out per the statutory schedule, with records retained on file.

**Worker qualifications.** Field staff hold relevant occupational safety qualifications, including NOHS 61810-certified health and safety management practice.

**Service visits.** Content and scheduling of maintenance visits are agreed with centre management and logged for each visit.

### Commercial terms

**Cost breakdown.** A cost breakdown is provided by category in the pricing appendix. **Pricing structure.** Pricing follows a unit-price structure.

### Forms

A tax payment certificate is enclosed.

### Quotation format

Submitted as a single PDF, without password protection. Price stated as EUR/m2/year. This response is within the 20-page limit excluding annexes. Pricing under the framework is quoted in EUR.

### Annex A -- additional technical requirements

The building envelope condition is assessed periodically and reported to centre management. A safety plan is in place for all work. Lift servicing is carried out to the applicable requirements.

### Annex B -- commercial and forms

The annex's technical cross-reference notes a 2-hour response-time figure. A volume discount structure applies under the framework.

Visakoivu Oy confirms its intention to submit this quotation.
